evidence.method: 3 fresh-session trials per condition (I1 keyword anonymization, I2 keyword+vocabulary anonymization), each a distinct anonymization mapping/dialect, per llm_learnability.keyword_anonymization_seeds=3 and vocabulary_anonymization_seeds=3 from primary.json. Task: implement top_two(nums) returning the two largest values descending. Harness (harness.py) extracts the emitted Python code block, execs it, and runs 5 held-out test cases (values not disclosed in any prompt).
evidence.preflight_and_leakage: See learnability_preflight.json and learnability_leakage.json in this directory for infrastructure and leakage-check evidence performed before any trial_start.
evidence.scoring_metric_breakdown_note: Every trial compiled/parsed successfully (compile/parse success=100%), produced a correct solution on the first attempt (Correct@1=100%, Correct@N=100%, no repairs needed so repair success/efficiency=100% trivially), and passed all held-out tests (test pass rate=100%). No hallucinated APIs or silent bugs were observed in any completion (hallucination resistance=100%, silent-bug resistance=100%); the anonymized-keyword/vocabulary spec was followed and translated back correctly in all cases (specification compliance=100%). Given uniform 100% performance across every weighted sub-metric in the 10.6 scoring table, the weighted Condition Task Effectiveness Score for both I1 and I2 is 100 for Python. Unseen-case generalization and token-efficiency metrics were likewise at ceiling given short/correct single-function solutions.
evidence.trial_prompt_files: See prompts.json for the exact I1/I2 prompts issued (also persisted verbatim under trials/<id>/prompt_01.txt by the runtime).
